answer: We bind each agent identity to a bonded stake escrowed on an isolated island of the state tree, so spawning a sybil requires locking fresh capital rather than cloning reputation. A commit-reveal reef of cross-attestations then forces colluders to expose correlated order flow, letting the lagoon of honest liquidity detect anomalous clustering before rewards vest. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
